translations.web: You shall fear Yahweh your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.
translations.bsb: Fear the LORD your God, serve Him only, and take your oaths in His name.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.
translations.asv: Thou shalt fear Jehovah thy God; and him shalt thou serve, and shalt swear by his name.
